title: Kao Soi
description: Chiang Mai-Style Curry Noodle (Kao Soi) recipe by Kasma Loha-unchit.
copyright: Recipe Copyright © 2008 Kasma Loha-unchit. All rights reserved.
author: Kasma Loha-unchit
body:
This is a wonderfully rich and delicious noodle dish, found mainly in the north of Thailand.

This recipe is only available in a PDF Version. (Suitable for printing, opens in new window.)

Also available: Kasma's feature article on Northern-Style Noodles.

If you're in Thailand and in Lampang, you can get Kao Soi at a great Lampang Noodle Shop.

Kasma taught this recipe in the Evening Series Advanced Set B-1.
